notes.author: codex
notes.text: KEY SDK FINDING: the pm-cli preflight-override runtime (extension-hook-runtime.js runPreflightOverride) wraps the callback in try/catch that SWALLOWS any throw into a non-fatal warning (extension_preflight_override_failed) and lets the command proceed. beforeCommand hooks do the same. So a bare throw CANNOT fail-fast. To genuinely abort before the command body, the override prints the actionable message to stderr and calls process.exit(EXIT_CODE.USAGE=2) — process termination bypasses the runtime catch. Proven functionally.
